name: Harry S. Truman
desc: president of the United States from 1945 to 1953; politician (1884–1972)
birthplace: Harry S Truman Birthplace State Historic Site
summary: Harry S. Truman  (May 8, 1884 – December 26, 1972) was the 33rd president of the United States, serving from 1945 to 1953. As the 34th vice president in 1945, he assumed the presidency upon the death of Franklin D. Roosevelt in April. Truman  set up the Marshall Plan to rebuild the badly damaged economy of Western Europe.
